**Credit name:** Francisco Couzo ([franciscouzo/square-packing](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing)). Original construction, seed and certificate credits are retained in the linked manifest.

Follow-up to [#672](https://github.com/jlevy/squares/issues/672).

Please register the **79 improved upper bounds** below. Each is strictly smaller than the [previous published repository bound](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/af8cb7959aead318c0cf5e9f873de3caa763f77a/upper_bounds.json) and the reviewed public comparison envelope, including pending submissions, deletion and repeated L borders. Only improved counts below 1024 are listed.

**Source commit:** [`c6da0fc7524d667bf3d224559724ba9b60762e60`](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/commit/c6da0fc7524d667bf3d224559724ba9b60762e60).

The comparisons include all Göbel squares, ordinary and corner strips, Friedman off-centre constructions, square tilings, repeated L borders and deletion. None matches or beats a bound in this table.

**Certificates:** values are rounded **upward** to 12 decimal places; the exact rational side in each certificate header is authoritative. If the linked witness contains more squares than the target count, delete the surplus squares. The [complete index](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/c6da0fc7524d667bf3d224559724ba9b60762e60/upper_bounds.json) records each relationship; the [manifest](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/c6da0fc7524d667bf3d224559724ba9b60762e60/certificates/best/manifest.json) records source credits, parent hashes and verification receipts.
